title: Cache upgrade crashes on startup
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the Redis cache as the broken part, a startup‑failure crash due to a bad config, and traces it to the new deploy.
root_cause: A newly deployed Redis container with an invalid 'maxmemory-policy' configuration failed to start, breaking cache connectivity and causing API 503 errors that disrupt product searches.
truth: A deploy upgraded Redis from 7.4 to 7.5; the new version refuses to start because the existing redis.conf uses a removed configuration directive, so the cache container crashes in a restart loop and the API cannot reach it.
